info.title: Downtown API Reference
info.description: REST API for the Downtown (DT) POS system. All responses use a standard envelope: `meta` (status, message, code, trace_id) and `data` or `errors`.

post.description:
Accepts an ordered array of category UUIDs and updates their `sort_order` accordingly.
All provided UUIDs must belong to categories under the same brand.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of product categories scoped to the authenticated user's brand access.
Categories are returned in a flat list; use `parent_category_id` to reconstruct the tree client-side.
